name: Hypholoma fasciculare

tip_speed.note: about 0.14 cm/day (1.4 mm/day x 41.7) read from the bar chart in Fig. 3: ungrazed mycelium growing over compressed non-sterile woodland soil at 16 C from 2 x 2 x 1 cm beech blocks, with two other fungi in the dish. Read by eye to about +/- 0.01 cm/day; about 0.13 cm/day at 20 C, not significantly different. Not corrected to the optimum temperature; the grazed treatments ranged from about 0.10 to 0.19 cm/day
tip_speed.source: A'Bear AD, Murray W, Webb R, Boddy L, Jones TH 2013, Contrasting effects of elevated temperature and invertebrate grazing regulate multispecies interactions between decomposer fungi, PLoS ONE 8(10):e77610

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

notes: Extension rate rises with temperature from 5 to 20 C [14]; the numeric rates are in papers that could not be opened. Reported (unchecked) to be strongly combative, shorter-range than Phanerochaete velutina, and used as a biocontrol against Armillaria.
